## Beta — Native entity picker actually loads

Home Assistant only loads its entity picker component when one of its own screens needs it, so when the rule dialog opened the picker was often not defined yet and the card fell back to the plain text field. The card now loads the picker explicitly and swaps the field for the native one as soon as it is available (keeping the value already typed or pre-filled). The plain text field with suggestions remains as a fallback if the picker cannot be loaded or fails to render.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/andker87/Home-Assistant-ChronoTask/compare/v1.4.0-beta4...v1.4.0-beta5
